verdict.rationale: Manufact ships an official MCP server that exposes the platform, organizations, servers, deployments, logs and observability as MCP tools. That lets users manage everything in natural language from Cursor, Claude or any MCP client, and authorization hands back a ready-made starter prompt. Publish checks also produce fix prompts for coding agents, plus a built-in autofix flow. Missing for 10: a native natural-language command interface inside the product itself (operation depends on an external agent client), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP-driven management works as claimed.
